entity.description:
The current Swamp Thing is Levi Kamei, a young scientist hailing from India raised within an environmentalist community who awaken his power as the next chosen Avatar of the Green in the wake of his father's death and is supported by Alec Holland. Kamei is associated with the Parliament of Trees, the Justice League, Justice League Dark, and the Titans.

The Swamp Thing was created by Len Wein and Bernie Wrightson, first appearing in (1971).
